description: One call with the inputs for thinking about a standing bid on the Branch license auction of The Standard Reserve (TSR), on Robinhood Chain, at a max unit price. Returns when the price reaches that max (derived, today or on the next auction day, with the stated assumption), how many other bids and licenses would be filled before it and the supply left after them (derived), and, with charter_id, that charter's measured pending STANDARD, window and branch caps and any existing bid a new one would replace. Also states how fills happen and the measured fill history: fill() is a separate transaction that anyone may send, so a price crossing is not a fill. Each part comes back under parts.<name> with its own status (ok, not_ready, or error). Requires max_unit_price. It returns inputs only and does not recommend an action.

charter_id.description: Optional charter id. Adds that charter's pending, caps and existing bid, and leaves its own bid out of the queue.

count.description: Licenses the bid would ask for, 1 to 3 (default 1).

max_unit_price.description: The ceiling per license, in whole STANDARD tokens as a positive decimal string (not wei), up to 18 decimal places.

name: 1s_std_decision_bid
title: TSR Decision: Bid
